patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenPhone and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

OpenPhone and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose OpenPhone only if your buying job matches “Modern SMB shared business phone (also branded Quo) with shared numbers, SMS and Sona AI —” rather than Zoom's shape. Choose Zoom only if your buying job matches “Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floo” rather than OpenPhone's shape. Workflow advantage: OpenPhone leans sales-calling; Zoom leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenPhone and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: OpenPhone is Modern SMB shared business phone (also branded Quo) with shared numbers, SMS and Sona AI — Starter from $15/user/month annual.; Zoom is Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floor ~$15–16/user/month; free meetings/chat exist but.
- Company-size focus: OpenPhone (solo, small-business, mid-market) vs Zoom (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: OpenPhone-leaning sales-calling vs Zoom-leaning —.
- Researched limits: OpenPhone — US/Canada-centric calling footprint — not a global UCaaS carrier story; Zoom — Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service.

Limitations — OpenPhone: US/Canada-centric calling footprint — not a global UCaaS carrier story; Phone menus, automatic recording and deeper CRM require Business or above; Zoom: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service; Phone seat floors and Pro Plus / Business Plus bundles are medium confidence and region-sensitive.

Poor-fit cases: OpenPhone is a poor fit when that limitation bites: US/Canada-centric calling footprint — not a global UCaaS carrier story · Zoom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service · Avoid OpenPhone if you actually need Zoom's motion (Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited res)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
